welcome:
Welcome to the GitLab CI/CD CLI Playground.
Type commands to explore a simulated GitLab project with pipelines.
Type 'help' for available commands, 'scenario' for guided labs.

steps.instruction: First, check recent pipelines to find the failing one.
Pipeline #4821 failed. View its details to see which job broke.
The 'unit-test' job failed. Check its logs to see the error.
The test failed due to a missing DB_HOST variable. Check the CI variables.
DB_HOST is missing. Set it so the pipeline can connect to the test database.
steps.hint: Try: glab variable set DB_HOST db-test.internal.example.com

steps.instruction: Good. Now retry the failed pipeline to pick up the new variable.
Check the pipeline status to confirm it's passing now.
All green. View the pipeline in the browser to share with your team.

scenarios.title: Set Up and Run a CI Pipeline

steps.instruction: Before pushing, validate the .gitlab-ci.yml syntax locally.
Good, the config is valid. Check the current auth status with GitLab.
Now trigger a new pipeline run on the main branch.
Pipeline #4822 started. Watch its status as it progresses.
The build and test stages passed. Check if artifacts were generated.
steps.hint: Try: glab ci artifact download 4822 build

steps.instruction: Artifacts downloaded. Now trigger a pipeline with a custom variable for deploy target.
steps.hint: Try: glab ci run --branch main --variables DEPLOY_ENV=staging

steps.instruction: Check the list of pipelines to see both runs.
The staging deploy pipeline is running. View the runner status to ensure capacity.

commands.help:
Available commands:
  glab ci list                   — List recent pipelines
  glab ci view <id>              — View pipeline details
  glab ci status <id>            — Check pipeline status
  glab ci run                    — Trigger a new pipeline
  glab ci retry <id>             — Retry a failed pipeline
  glab ci trace <id> <job>       — View job logs
  glab ci lint                   — Validate .gitlab-ci.yml
  glab ci get <id>               — Get pipeline JSON details
  glab ci delete <id>            — Delete a pipeline
  glab ci artifact               — Download job artifacts
  glab mr list                   — List merge requests
  glab mr create                 — Create a merge request
  glab mr view <id>              — View merge request
  glab mr merge <id>             — Merge a merge request
  glab mr diff <id>              — View MR diff
  glab issue list                — List issues
  glab issue create              — Create an issue
  glab issue view <id>           — View issue details
  glab repo view                 — View repository info
  glab repo clone                — Clone a repository
  glab auth status               — Check authentication
  glab variable list             — List CI/CD variables
  glab variable set              — Set a CI/CD variable
  glab variable delete           — Delete a CI/CD variable
  gitlab-runner list             — List registered runners
  gitlab-runner verify           — Verify runner connections
  gitlab-runner status           — Check runner service status
  gitlab-runner run              — Start a runner

  scenario                       — Start a guided lab
  clear                          — Clear the terminal
  help                           — Show this help

Issue #892 — Pipeline timeout on large batch jobs

Status:     open
Author:     priya.sharma
Created:    1 day ago
Labels:     bug, ci-cd, priority::high
Milestone:  v2.5.0
Assignee:   ravi.kumar

Description:
  The nightly batch processing pipeline times out when
  processing end-of-month salary disbursement files.
  Current job timeout is 30m but batch jobs need ~45m
  during month-end peak (50K+ transactions).

  Proposed fix: increase timeout for batch jobs or
  implement chunked processing.
